description: This file implements cryptographic random number generation functions, including reseeding and generating random values of various sizes, with fallback mechanisms for different platforms and configurations.

methods.name: Reseed
methods.description: Reseeds the random number generator, using platform-specific methods and fallback to legacy random functions.

methods.name: Random
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure or fallback random value of various sizes (uint8_t, uint16_t, uint32_t, uint64_t).
